parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The **ClientToken** value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the security group rule. The description must be 1 to 512 characters in length.

parameters.name: DestCidrIp
parameters.description:
The destination IPv4 Classless Inter-Domain Routing (CIDR) block. CIDR format and IPv4 format IP address range are supported.

Default value: null.

parameters.name: DestGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the destination security group for which you want to configure access permissions. Set at least one of `DestGroupId` and `DestCidrIp`.

- Set at least one of DestGroupId, DestCidrIp, Ipv6DestCidrIp, and DestPrefixListId.
- If DestGroupId is specified but DestCidrIp is not specified, the NicType parameter can be set only to intranet.
- If both DestGroupId and DestCidrIp are specified, DestCidrIp takes precedence by default.

parameters.name: DestGroupOwnerAccount
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud account that manages the destination security group when you set a security group rule across accounts.

parameters.name: DestGroupOwnerId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that manages the destination security group when you set a security group rule across accounts.

parameters.name: DestPrefixListId
parameters.description:
The ID of the destination prefix list. You can call [DescribePrefixLists](~~205046~~) to query available prefix list IDs.

This parameter is ignored if you specify one of `DestCidrIp`, `Ipv6DestCidrIp`, or `DestGroupId`.

parameters.name: IpProtocol
parameters.description:
The network layer or transport layer protocol. Two types of values are supported:
1. Case-insensitive protocol names. Valid values:
- ICMP
- GRE
- TCP
- UDP
- ALL: all protocols are supported.
2. Protocol numbers that comply with the IANA specification, which are integers from 0 to 255. The following regions currently support this feature:
- Philippines
- UK (London)
- Malaysia
- China (Hohhot)
- China (Qingdao)
- US (Virginia)
- Singapore

parameters.name: Ipv6DestCidrIp
parameters.description:
The destination IPv6 Classless Inter-Domain Routing (CIDR) block. CIDR format and IPv6 format IP address range are supported.

> Only VPC-type IP addresses are supported. This parameter and `DestCidrIp` cannot be specified at the same time. Settings for this parameter and `DestCidrIp` are mutually exclusive.

Default value: null.

parameters.name: Ipv6SourceCidrIp
parameters.description:
The source IPv6 Classless Inter-Domain Routing (CIDR) block. CIDR format and IPv6 format IP address range are supported.

> Only VPC-type IP addresses are supported. Settings for this parameter and `SourceCidrIp` are mutually exclusive.

Default value: null.

parameters.name: NicType
parameters.description:
The network interface controller (NIC) type.

> When you modify a rule by specifying the security group rule ID, this parameter cannot be modified. To make such a change, add a new rule and then delete the current rule.

parameters.name: Policy
parameters.description:
The access permissions. Valid values:

- accept: accepts access.
- drop: deny access and does not return a rejection response.

Default value: accept.

parameters.name: PortRange
parameters.description:
The range of destination ports that correspond to the transport layer protocol. Valid values:

- For TCP/UDP: valid values are 1 to 65535. Separate the start port and the end port with a forward slash (/). Example: 1/200.
- For ICMP: -1/-1.
- For GRE: -1/-1.
- For ALL: -1/-1.

parameters.name: PortRangeListId
parameters.description:
The port address book ID.
You can call `DescribePortRangeLists` to query available port address book IDs.

This parameter is ignored if you specify the PortRange parameter.

For more information, see [Security group limits](~~25412#SecurityGroupQuota1~~).

parameters.name: Priority
parameters.description:
The priority of the security group rule. Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 1.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the source security group. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: SecurityGroupId
parameters.description: The security group ID.

parameters.name: SecurityGroupRuleId
parameters.description: The security group rule ID. You can call [DescribeSecurityGroupAttribute](~~2679845~~) to query security group rule IDs.

parameters.name: SourceCidrIp
parameters.description:
The source IPv4 Classless Inter-Domain Routing (CIDR) block. CIDR format and IPv4 format IP address range are supported.

Default value: null.

parameters.name: SourcePortRange
parameters.description:
The range of source ports that correspond to the transport layer protocol. Valid values:

- For TCP/UDP: valid values are 1 to 65535. Separate the start port and the end port with a forward slash (/). Example: 1/200.
- For ICMP: -1/-1.
- For GRE: -1/-1.
- For ALL: -1/-1.
